---
title: Skip-to-content link (custom page layout)
format:
  html:
    page-layout: custom
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - 'a#quarto-skip-link[href="#quarto-document-content"]'
          # Deliberate divergence from Quarto 1 (bd-rbd3jq4n): q2 keeps
          # `<main>` under `page-layout: custom`, so `<main>` is the target.
          # Quarto 1 has no `<main>` here and targets
          # `div.page-layout-custom` instead.
          - 'main#quarto-document-content[tabindex="-1"]'
        - []
---

Some custom content.
